about: fk-stopwatch's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk1-tick-never-armed
mutants.from:
case Running:
		Some{Timeout[Signal]{In: TickEvery, Signal: Ticked}}
mutants.rule: The Running state owns the tick: its entry arms Ticked after TickEvery.

mutants.name: fk1-start-while-running-reenters
mutants.to:
case (Running as r, Start):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Running{Elapsed: r.Elapsed}}
	case (Stopped, Stop), (Stopped, Ticked):
		Ignore
mutants.rule: A start while running keeps the entry: re-entering Running would restart the tick and lose the time since the last one (law ElapsedCountsTicksWhileRunning).

mutants.name: fk1-reset-keeps-time
mutants.rule: Reset is the initial watch from any state.

mutants.name: fk1-format-cents
mutants.rule: The shown hundredths are the milliseconds of the second over ten, rounded down.

mutants.name: fk1-format-minutes-wrap
mutants.rule: Minutes are whole minutes, not wrapped at an hour, as upstream's formatTime.
